$comment: Cells that must NOT be commissioned, with who holds each and why. A hold is checked before any local evidence is read, so a cell that looks perfect in today's capture still stays held — the holder knows something a capture run cannot see. This file exists because the alternative is a hold that lives only in one agent's session: it is lost on a reset, and the cell is then commissioned by whoever looks next and finds nothing wrong with it. The review tool removes a released entry from held and appends an attributed hold/release record to history; history begins with schema version 2.

priorReasons.functional/effect-msaa-bloom/canvas: WebGPU silently normalizes the requested effect-target sampleCount 4 to 1 while WebGL renders at 4 and Canvas antialiases; release after the WebGPU sample-count seam is resolved and current parity passes SECOND CONDITION, independent of the determinism question: this canvas cell is measured against siblings that render on a FLOAT target — effect-effect-msaa-bloom.webgl.ts and .webgpu.ts both build their pipeline with format: 'rgba16f' (verified in source, not assumed), while Canvas 2D has no float path and clamps to [0,1] before the effect's threshold is applied. ★ NO MEASUREMENT STANDS BEHIND THIS YET: the divergence originally cited here has since been traced to canvas clamping bloom's intensity to 1 and to its per-channel bright pass, both since fixed, and dropping the Gl target from rgba16f to rgba8 leaves the core byte-identical — evidence AGAINST the format mattering for this scene. Whoever releases this hold should establish a measurement rather than inherit mine.
